momentum_breakout.name: Momentum Breakout
momentum_breakout.description: Buys when a coin is up more than 5% in 24h AND the Fear & Greed Index is above 50 (Greed territory). Momentum tends to persist in crypto — coins breaking out with positive sentiment often continue for 2-5 more days. Wider stop to avoid shakeouts.

confidence_formula: confidence = base(0.55) + fear_bonus(0-0.15) + momentum_bonus(0-0.10). Max 0.80. Base is just above coin flip to be honest about uncertainty. Fear bonus scales with how extreme the Fear & Greed is. Momentum bonus scales with the size of the 24h price move.
